description: Four preset scenario cards pre-fill the moment textarea and can be edited before continuing
steps: Navigate to /journey
Verify four preset cards are visible: 'Just started uni', 'First job in the city', 'New to Australia', 'Moved from another city'
Click the 'New to Australia' card
Verify the card shows a selected state (distinct border/background and CheckCircle2 badge)
Verify a textarea appears below the cards pre-filled with the preset's full text
Edit the textarea to change a word
Verify the continue button becomes active once the 30-character minimum is met and a suburb + topic are also filled
Click a different preset card
Verify the textarea updates to that preset's text
Verify the previously selected card deselects

description: 'Write your own' link opens a blank textarea without selecting any preset card
steps: Navigate to /journey
Click 'Something else? Write your own'
Verify a blank textarea appears
Verify no preset card is selected
Type fewer than 30 characters
Verify a character-count hint appears (e.g. '12/30 characters')
Type until 30+ characters
Verify the hint disappears and the textarea border turns teal

description: Checklist chips in onboarding toggle correctly and the ticked items suppress the corresponding guides from the plan
steps: Navigate to /journey
Locate the 'Already sorted?' checklist section
Verify five chips are visible: Myki card, GP registered, Bank account, SIM card, Lease signed
Click 'GP registered'
Verify it shows a checked state (tick icon, teal border and background)
Click 'GP registered' again
Verify it returns to unchecked state
Check 'GP registered' and 'Lease signed'
Complete the rest of the form and proceed to /journey/plan
Verify 'finding-a-gp-before-you-need-one' does not appear on the health-wellbeing day (Day 5 defaults to 'crisis-lines-you-can-actually-call' instead)
Verify 'renting-without-getting-burned' and 'your-bond-starts-on-day-one' do not appear across any day

feature: Onboarding — Hide/Show How It Works Sidebar
description: Desktop sidebar can be toggled via a button in the onboarding form header
steps: Navigate to /journey on a desktop viewport (≥1024px)
Verify the 'How it works' sidebar is visible by default
Click the 'Hide guide' button in the top-right of the form
Verify the sidebar animates out and is no longer visible
Verify the button label changes to 'How it works'
Click the button again
Verify the sidebar animates back in

description: Days 1, 2, 5, 6, 7 always map to fixed topics regardless of user topic selection
steps: Complete onboarding selecting only 'Health & Wellbeing' and 'Social & Belonging'
Proceed to /journey/plan
Verify Day 1 tab shows the Food/Sandwich icon and is labelled 'Survive'
Verify Day 2 tab shows the Home icon and is labelled 'Admin'
Verify Day 5 tab covers Health & Wellbeing (labelled 'Health')
Verify Day 6 tab covers Social & Belonging (labelled 'Connect')
Verify Day 7 tab covers Getting Around (labelled 'Routine')
Start over and repeat with a completely different topic selection (e.g. Getting Around + Food & Eating)
Verify Days 1, 2, 5, 6, 7 still map to the same topics as before

description: Days 3 and 4 reflect the user's first and second selected topics; a single selection fills both slots
steps: Complete onboarding selecting 'Getting Around' first, then 'Health & Wellbeing'
Proceed to /journey/plan
Verify Day 3 shows a Getting Around guide (first guide: 'getting-myki-and-surviving-ptv')
Verify Day 4 shows a Health & Wellbeing guide (first guide: 'finding-a-gp-before-you-need-one')
Start over and repeat onboarding selecting 'Social & Belonging' only
Verify Day 3 shows 'when-you-dont-know-anyone-yet' (first social guide, day-1 arcOrder=6)
Verify Day 4 shows 'surviving-the-first-weekend-alone' (second social guide, day-1 arcOrder=9)

description: Moment text containing 'international' or 'overseas' boosts the medicare guide to the front of the health-wellbeing queue
steps: Complete onboarding with moment text containing 'I arrived from overseas recently' (30+ characters)
Select any topics and proceed to /journey/plan
Navigate to Day 5 (health-wellbeing)
Verify the guide shown is 'medicare-bulk-billing-and-mental-health-care-plans' — normally this guide sits behind three day-1 health guides, so boost is required to surface it
Start over with moment text that does not contain international/overseas keywords
Navigate to Day 5 and verify the guide shown is 'finding-a-gp-before-you-need-one' (the default first health-wellbeing guide: day-1, arcOrder=3)

description: Moment text containing 'budget', 'broke', or 'afford' promotes cheap-eats and budgeting guides to the front of their topic queues
steps: Complete onboarding with moment text containing 'I can not afford much right now' (30+ characters)
Proceed to /journey/plan
Navigate to Day 1 (food-eating)
Verify the guide shown is 'cheap-eats-when-broke' — normally 'your-first-grocery-run' wins (day-1 arcOrder=1), so boost is required
Navigate to Day 2 (home-admin)
Verify the guide shown is 'budgeting-on-what-you-actually-earn' — normally 'your-first-48-hours-checklist' wins (day-1 arcOrder=5), so boost is required
Start over with neutral moment text and verify Day 1 defaults back to 'your-first-grocery-run'

description: Moment text containing 'anxious' or 'overwhelmed' surfaces crisis lines as the health-wellbeing guide
steps: Complete onboarding with moment text containing 'I feel quite anxious about all of this' (30+ characters)
Proceed to /journey/plan
Navigate to the health-wellbeing day (Day 5)
Verify the guide shown is 'crisis-lines-you-can-actually-call' — both crisis-lines and psych are boosted; crisis-lines wins the tie because it is day-1 arc vs psych's month-1
Start over with neutral moment text and verify Day 5 defaults to 'finding-a-gp-before-you-need-one'

description: Each day's content panel shows exactly one guide card, not two
steps: Complete onboarding and proceed to /journey/plan
Click each day tab in turn (Day 1 through Day 7)
For each day, count the number of guide cards rendered in the content panel
Verify exactly one guide card is visible per day
Verify no second guide card appears below the first

description: Each day shows a single actionable task that can be toggled complete
steps: Navigate to /journey/plan
Verify a 'Your task today' row is visible below the guide card
Verify the row contains a concrete action sentence (not a generic placeholder)
Verify the task shows an unchecked Square icon initially
Click the task row
Verify the Square icon becomes a CheckCircle2 icon
Verify the task text is struck through and turns teal
Click the task row again
Verify it reverts to unchecked state

description: Completing a day's task marks the day tab with a tick badge visible in the tab strip
steps: Navigate to /journey/plan
Select Day 2
Click the 'Your task today' row to mark it complete
Verify a CheckCircle2 tick badge appears in the top-right corner of the Day 2 tab
Click a different day tab
Verify the Day 2 tab retains its tick while inactive
Click Day 2 again and untick the task
Verify the tick badge disappears from the Day 2 tab

description: Each day's content shows up to 3 relevant nearby places inline, driven by the day's topic and the user's suburb
steps: Complete onboarding with suburb 'Clayton' and proceed to /journey/plan
Navigate to Day 1 (food-eating)
Verify a 'Places to go today in Clayton' section appears below the guide card and task
Verify the section subtitle mentions 'cheap supermarkets & community meals'
Verify up to 3 place entries are listed, each showing a name and address
Navigate to the health-wellbeing day
Verify the subtitle changes to 'bulk-billing GPs & pharmacies'
Navigate to the getting-around day
Verify the subtitle changes to 'transport & Myki top-up points'
Verify place entries update to match the new topic

feature: Plan — Sidebar as Week Progress Tracker
description: The desktop sidebar shows 'Your week at a glance' — an ordered list of all 7 days, not a nearby-services panel
steps: Navigate to /journey/plan on a desktop viewport (≥1024px)
Verify the right-hand sidebar is labelled 'Your week at a glance'
Verify it lists all 7 days with their theme names and first guide title
Verify the active day is highlighted (teal background or teal text)
Click a different day in the sidebar list
Verify the main content panel switches to that day
Verify no 'nearby services' or map panel appears in the sidebar

description: Sidebar shows a done count once at least one day is completed
steps: Navigate to /journey/plan with no completed days
Verify no progress count text is shown in the sidebar
Complete Day 1's task
Verify the sidebar now shows '1 of 7 days done'
Complete Day 3's task
Verify the sidebar updates to '2 of 7 days done'

feature: State Persistence — localStorage (Plan Survives Tab Close)
description: Journey state is stored in localStorage so the plan is restored after closing and reopening the tab
steps: Complete onboarding and arrive at /journey/plan
Note the suburb and which guides appear on Days 1 and 2
Close the browser tab
Open a new tab and navigate to /journey/plan
Verify the plan is restored — suburb name appears in the header
Verify the same guides appear on Days 1 and 2 as before tab close
Verify the user is not redirected back to /journey

feature: State Persistence — Completed Days Survive Refresh
description: Days marked as complete remain complete after a page refresh
steps: Navigate to /journey/plan
Mark Day 1 and Day 3 as complete via the task checkbox
Verify both day tabs show tick badges
Refresh the browser
Verify Day 1 and Day 3 still show tick badges after refresh
Verify the sidebar progress count reflects 2 completed days
Verify Day 2 and other days remain unchecked

feature: Start Over — Clears Both Storage Keys
description: Clicking 'Start over' clears journey state and completed days, then returns to onboarding
steps: Navigate to /journey/plan
Mark at least two days as complete
Click the 'Start over' button in the header
Verify the browser routes to /journey
Verify the onboarding form is blank (no pre-filled moment, no suburb, no topics selected, no checklist ticked)
Complete onboarding again and proceed to /journey/plan
Verify no day tabs show tick badges
Verify the progress count is absent from the sidebar
